answer: Each agent’s EigenTrust score is derived from normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust propagated through the reputation matrix. Exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life discounts stale endorsements, so meaningful centrality requires sustained honest service. A freshly spawned Sybil has no credible incoming paths and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; multiplying hollow identities cannot establish trusted mass or pass consensus, even when clustered around a summit vertex.
